caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a metallic, copper-colored oil lamp with a rounded base and a curved handle on its left side. The body of the lamp has a slight reflective sheen and is topped with a short, cylindrical wick holder where a white wick protrudes. Attached to the front of the lamp is a hinged, triangular-shaped metallic cover that is lifted open, revealing a curved, clear glass shield positioned vertically, likely designed to protect the flame. The background of the drawing is a plain off-white color, and there is a small inscription in red text toward the lower right corner of the image. The composition is centered, with the lamp being the only object depicted.
title: Bull's Eye Hand Lantern
